rationale: Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Custom job timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) with 5-minute limits on both jobs, supported by experimental evidence showing ~27% elapsed time reduction on a similar Node.js lint/typecheck workflow (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508). The current CI history shows runs complete in ~23-30 seconds, so 5 minutes provides ample headroom while bounding runaway executions. (2) Cancel superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) via a concurrency group keyed by workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress: true, supported by literature evidence (pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) showing 1.9-4.1% VM time reduction. This is safe for PR/push CI workflows without release/deployment steps. The existing npm cache via setup-node@cache is preserved. Matrix fail-fast remains false to preserve full cross-version test coverage.
